get.description:
Accept dossier token, bookyear Id, Journal Type Id and modifiedTimeStamp and return modified and deleted bookings lists.

This API call returns a detailed report of all operations that have occurred in the open dossier.To avoid overloading the web service, it is necessary to request the data in a controlled manner.
If no previous synchronizations have been performed, it is mandatory to first request the data per fiscal year and per journal type.It is not required to synchronize ALL fiscal years. The fiscal years can be easily retrieved with the API call GetBookyears.

Parameters:
  • BookyearKey: From the list of fiscal years (keys) via GetBookyears
  • JournalType: 1 = Purchases, 2 = Sales, 3 = Financial, 4 = Various operations
  • modifiedTimeStamp: Date since last synchronization

Initial situation: - no data synchronized: modifiedTimeStamp = 1980-01-01 00:00:00.000
GetBookyears Returns 3 fiscal years (1, 2, 3)
  • BookyearKey 1
    • GetReportModifiedBooking for bookyearkey 1, journal type 1, modifiedTimeStamp = 1980-01-01 00:00:00.000
    • GetReportModifiedBooking for bookyearkey 1, journal type 2, modifiedTimeStamp = 1980-01-01 00:00:00.000
    • GetReportModifiedBooking for bookyearkey 1, journal type 3, modifiedTimeStamp = 1980-01-01 00:00:00.000
    • GetReportModifiedBooking for bookyearkey 1, journal type 4, modifiedTimeStamp = 1980-01-01 00:00:00.000
  • BookyearKey 2
    • GetReportModifiedBooking for bookyearkey 2, journal type 1, modifiedTimeStamp = 1980-01-01 00:00:00.000
    • GetReportModifiedBooking for bookyearkey 2, journal type 2, modifiedTimeStamp = 1980-01-01 00:00:00.000
    • ...
  • BookyearKey 3
    • GetReportModifiedBooking for bookyearkey 3, journal type 1, modifiedTimeStamp = 1980-01-01 00:00:00.000
    • GetReportModifiedBooking for bookyearkey 3, journal type 2, modifiedTimeStamp = 1980-01-01 00:00:00.000
    • ...

So after three times four calls, all data from the three fiscal years has been received.Then one can receive the incremental changes to all fiscal years by executing the call with:

BookyearKey: -1 JournalType: -1 modifiedTimeStamp: 2022-08-01 14:52:45.000


This will return only modified bookings since that date.
modifiedTimeStampTo is optional and can be used to specify the end of the time range to filter modified bookings, to limit the amount of data returned.

Maximum allowed calls per day: 48

post.description:
Generate Invoices and send them using peppol if possible (if the recipient is registered to receive the document type and a valid UBL can be created). If the recipient is not registered the invoice will be mailed (if the relation has a valid email address). If the recipient is registered but a valid UBL can not be created, the invoice will not be sent !

Rendering of the pdf is server-side. Since generating the invoices is time consuming, relatively small batches of invoices should be sent.
If mail is used, unless there is a correct SPF record allowing us to send mails on behalf of the given from-address, it will be sent from a no-reply address on our domain with the reply-to address set to the given from-address.
If the mail recipient is a private individual only a pdf is attached, otherwise a pdf and a xml is attached.
More information on how to create a correct SPF record can be found [here](https://www.octopus.be/nl/portaal-spf-record-aanmaken).

Maximum allowed calls per day: 400

200.description: SendInvoice response returned.  Attention: this response code only means the call could be processed successfully.  It does not guarantee that all, or any, invoice was actually successfully sent.  The returned object contains the status info for all processed documents. transactionCode.description:
Transaction code :
  • 11 : Transactions involving actual change of ownership with financial compensation. Outright sale/purchase except direct trade with/by private consumers or other compensation(except the transactions listed under 2, 7, and 8).
  • 12 : Transactions involving actual change of ownership with financial compensation
    Direct trade with/by private consumers (incl. distance sale)
  • 21 : Return and replacement of goods free of charge after registration of the original transaction. Return of goods.
  • 22 : Return and replacement of goods free of charge after registration of the original transaction. Replacement for returned goods.
  • 23 : Return and replacement of goods free of charge after registration of the original transaction. Replacement (e.g. under warranty) for goods not being returned.
  • 31 : Transactions involving intended change of ownership or change of ownership without financial compensation. Movements to/from a warehouse (excluding call-off and consignment stock)
  • 32 : Transactions involving intended change of ownership or change of ownership without financial compensation. Supply for sale on approval or after trial (including call-off and consignment stock).
  • 33 : Transactions involving intended change of ownership or change of ownership without financial compensation. Financial leasing
  • 34 : Transactions involving intended change of ownership or change of ownership without financial compensation. Transactions involving transfer of ownership without financial compensation
  • 41 : Transactions with a view to processing under contract (not involving change of ownership).Goods expected to return to the initial Member State/country of export
  • 42 : Transactions with a view to processing under contract (not involving change of ownership). Goods not expected to return to the initial Member State/country of export
  • 51 : Transactions following processing under contract (not involving change of ownership). Goods returning to the initial Member State/country of export
  • 52 : Transactions following processing under contract (not involving change of ownership). Goods not returning to the initial Member State/country of export.
  • 60 : Operations following repair or maintenance. This service can be both free of charge or against payment. These operations do not involve a (future) transfer of ownership.
  • 71 : Transactions with a view to/following customs clearance (not involving change of ownership,
    related to goods in quasi-import or export). Release of goods for free circulation in a Member State with a subsequent export to another Member State.
  • 72 : Transactions with a view to/following customs clearance (not involving change of ownership, related to goods in quasi-import or export
    Transportation of goods from one Member State to another Member State to place the goods under the export procedure.
  • 80 : Transactions involving the supply of building materials and technical equipment under a general construction or civil engineering contract for which no separate invoicing of the goods is required and an invoice for the total contract is issued.
  • 91 : Other transactions which cannot be classified under other codes. Hire, loan, and operational leasing longer than 24 months.
  • 92 : Other transactions which cannot be classified under other codes. Other.
